subject: Taxes
title: The Child Tax Credit
description: A quick win: understand The Child Tax Credit.

hook.text: Parents get a $2,000 tax credit per child under 17.

buildup.text: The credit directly reduces your tax bill. Up to $1,700 is refundable—even if you owe no tax, you can get cash back.

discovery.text: In 2021, the expanded credit was sent as monthly checks.

twist.text: Congress let the expansion expire in 2022. Child poverty rates immediately jumped back to pre-expansion levels.

climax.text: The child tax credit showed that tax policy can eliminate child poverty—if the political will exists to fund it.

punchline.text: Cut child poverty 30% in six months. Then Congress let it expire.

quiz.question: What happened to child poverty when the expanded child tax credit expired?
options: It jumped back to pre-expansion levels
